meta.title: 负空间-摄影视觉语言系列课程 第二集
meta.title_en: Negative Space: Photography Visual Language, Ep.2

scenes.context: 负空间是指画面中主体周围的空白区域，它和主体一起构成完整的画面平衡。
sentences: 负空间是主体周围的空白。
Negative space is the area around the subject.
paraphrase: Negative space is the area around the subject.
scenes.speak: Negative space is the area around the subject. It balances the composition.

scenes.context: 空白不是无内容，负空间同样在传递信息：环境、氛围、情绪都靠它支撑。
scenes.speak: Empty areas still carry meaning. Mood leans on negative space.

scenes.context: 留白越多，主体越突出，负空间把观众视线牢牢引向被摄对象。
sentences: The eye lands on the subject.
paraphrase: The eye lands on the subject.
scenes.speak: More space, stronger subject. The eye lands on the subject.

scenes.context: 天空、水面、纯色墙面、虚化的背景都是负空间，不同材质传递不同情绪。
sentences: Sky and water are negative space.
Each surface carries its own mood.
paraphrase: Sky and water are negative space.
Each surface carries its own mood.
scenes.speak: Sky and water are negative space. Each surface carries its own mood.

scenes.context: 主体太小会显得空洞，太大又拥挤，负空间的比例决定画面的呼吸感。
sentences: Subject size must balance the space.
paraphrase: Subject size must balance the space.
scenes.speak: Subject size must balance the space. Ratio sets the breathing room.

scenes.context: 拍摄前先看背景里有没有干净的留白区域，构图时主动为负空间留位置。
sentences: First hunt for clean open areas.
paraphrase: First hunt for clean open areas.
scenes.speak: First hunt for clean open areas. Compose space on purpose.

scenes.context: 商业片和海报常利用负空间放文案、放品牌，让画面透气又高级。
sentences: It keeps the frame airy and classy.
paraphrase: It keeps the frame airy and classy.
scenes.speak: Posters use space for text. It keeps the frame airy and classy.

scenes.context: 学会使用负空间，是摄影从记录走向表达的第二步，少即是多。
sentences: Negative space is an expressive tool.
paraphrase: Negative space is an expressive tool.
用less is more换一种说法
scenes.speak: Negative space is an expressive tool. Less is more.

practice: Negative space is the area around the subject.
The eye lands on the subject.

pitfalls: 负空间引导视线，越简洁越有力
负空间传递环境氛围情绪
太满拥挤太空洞，平衡才高级
difficult_words: 负空间，主体周围的留白区域
